utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Kira, the repair drive is this weekend. Priority jobs are Mrs. Park’s leaking gutter and the loose porch rail, and Oren’s promised to help on the day.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Leo—but can you confirm the exact day, time, and meeting spot, and whether Oren’s definitely confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, Oren confirmed he’ll help on the day. I still need to pin down the exact time and meeting spot, so I’ll let you know once that’s set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad people are offering help, but I’m still worried about the basics—where we’ll put the tables, how we’ll label repairs, and who keeps the line moving if it gets crowded.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: You’re right, Pia—the logistics will make or break it, so I can ask the Oak Street crew for table help and the parents’ group for check-in and labeling. If you’ve got a preferred layout, I’ll fold that into the signup list before I pass it around.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would ease my mind, Jules—let’s plan for two check-in spots at the front, repair tables along the side, and a separate pickup area so finished items don’t clog the line.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara, I’m glad you checked in—right now we’re using the community room as the main drop-off, and I’m sorting repair items into categories as the lists come in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds perfect, Rosa—thank you for keeping the drop-off organized. I’ll keep gathering the repairable-item list and tool volunteers, and we can match them to your categories as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara—send me whatever you have by category when it’s ready, and I’ll fold it into the master list with the tool volunteers matched up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do you have the actual repair list yet, or should I wait on Nell and Hana before I start matching people to tools?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Mina, I’m afraid I don’t have the actual list yet—I was waiting on someone to point me back to the sign-up, so best check with Nell and Hana before you start matching tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, I’ll wait on Nell and Hana then—but if you find the signup first, send it to me straight away so we don’t lose time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, I’m still piecing things together while I’m out, but Jules is starting to match up tools, supplies, and spare hands. Have you heard of anyone with repairs waiting or resources to offer?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes—Jules is already gathering names for tools, spare parts, and time, and I’m waiting on Eli for the posted schedule and drop-off details. If I hear about folks with repairs waiting, I’ll send them your way too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s helpful, Vik—if Eli’s schedule shows up before I circle back, I’ll pass it along to Jules and point any repair requests your way too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Tess. We’re still collecting small repair requests and matching them with whoever has tools or time; I can check the notice board for the latest sign-up if you like.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be lovely, Uli—Gus said he’d check the board too, but if you can confirm the latest sign-up and any time or place details, I’ll make sure folks hear the right thing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll take a quiet look at the board this afternoon and compare it with what Gus finds, just so we don’t send anyone the wrong way. I’ll pass you the time, place, and sign-up details once I’m sure.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Eli, I’m still catching up through other folks—do you know who’s coordinating the repair drive, or where I can confirm the time and what tools are actually needed?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I don’t have the coordinator’s name or final time yet, Nell; I’m waiting for the posted details before I repeat anything. Once it’s confirmed, I’d like to write down the time, drop-off spot, and tool list in one clear place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds sensible, thanks—if you see the posted details before I do, could you let me know? I’ll hold off on telling Mina anything definite until it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Gus—quick version, it’s looking like lots of small appliances and bikes so far, but I’m still waiting on the full list before we start lining folks up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good to know, Bo—I’ll make sure my bike stand, tire kit, and small-appliance tools are ready, and I can hold off on lining folks up until you’ve got the full list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Gus—having those ready should cover a lot, and I’ll ping you once the full list lands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Dane — I’m checking the repair list and signup sheet now, but the urgent items Leo named are Mrs. Park’s loose porch rail and leaking gutter. I’ll confirm who’s actually signed up before I assign anyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Hana — I’m late catching up, but I can check with a couple handy neighbors this afternoon and see if anyone’s comfortable with a porch rail or gutter fix.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — please ask them which job they can handle and what tools or supplies they’d bring, and I’ll cross-check that against the signup sheet before we count them in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Opal, I’m pulling together the repair drive supply list—do you know if anyone has brought batteries, basic tools, or anything else yet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Cleo, I don’t have any confirmed batteries or basic tools logged yet—just the community room marked as the main drop-off for now. If you hear of any supplies coming in, send me the names and items and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep tape and spare screws tentative until I confirm the community room, and I’ll send you names and items as soon as Sam reports back on batteries and tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Noah, I’m helping Mara with the repair drive from 10 to noon, since that fits between school drop-off and pickup. I can help set up and stay through the whole window.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds really helpful, Faye—Mara will be glad to have someone steady for the full 10 to noon window. I might be behind, but I think they’re still sorting names and urgent repairs, so setup help should fit right in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s good to know, Noah—I’ll plan to arrive a little before 10 so I can help Mara get organized and see where the urgent repairs list stands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—would you like me to add you to the invite list or point any interested neighbors your way?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, please add me to the invite list, and feel free to point interested neighbors my way—I’m already checking who has spare screws, tape, batteries, and basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Fantastic, Sam—I’ll add you to the invite list and send folks your way if they’re offering supplies or need to coordinate tools. I’ll pass along the time and location as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Tess, I’m pulling together the repair drive supply list now—do you know if anyone has dropped off batteries, basic tools, or anything else I should mark down?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I know Gus is planning to bring his tool chest and spare fasteners, but I haven’t heard of any batteries being dropped off yet. He’s also checking the community board for the exact kickoff details, so I’ll pass along anything confirmed as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess — I’ll mark Gus’s tool chest and fasteners as expected, and keep batteries listed as still needed until we hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Opal, I’m just catching up while I’m out—have you heard what the repair drive needs most right now? I can pass any good leads along to Jules or swing by later if hands are needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Ira—right now I’ve only got the community room listed as the main drop-off, with the exact needs and any second location still undecided. If you hear from Jules, please send me the item list and I’ll add it to my tracker.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Opal—I’ll keep an ear out for Jules’s list and send it your way as soon as I hear anything definite. For now I’ll tell folks the community room is the drop-off and that the exact needs are still being sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, have you heard back from the organizers yet on the time and what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not yet, Mina—I’ve only heard the same second-hand bit about small appliances and bikes, so I’m going to check once more today and tell you as soon as I have a real time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell—please make sure they tell you the start time and the urgent repairs first, because I need to decide whether to bring tools or line up extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Gus, I’ve only heard pieces so far, but I’m trying to help quietly by checking what people need fixed and what tools or table space they can offer. What part of the repair drive are you most worried about?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly the flow of it, Rey—making sure folks know when to show up and that we’ve got enough table space, bins, and the right tools ready before things get crowded.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds practical; I can ask around one-on-one about extra tables, bins, and tools, and maybe help spread a simple time window so people don’t all arrive at once.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—would you like me to add you to the invite list, or know anyone nearby who might want the details?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, you can add me, thank you. Maybe add Oren too—he wants to help, and I promised I’d point him toward the signup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Uli—I’ll add you, and I’ll make sure Oren gets the signup details too. If you see him first, tell him I’m happy to connect him right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Eli, I’m helping Mara with the repair drive from 10 to noon, which fits between school runs. Are you planning to stop by or lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Faye, 10 to noon is clear enough for me—I’ll stop by and help keep the list sorted so folks know what’s being fixed and who has the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be a huge help, Eli—having the list organized will keep things moving smoothly. I’ll be there a little before 10 to help Mara set up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Sam, I’m trying to keep this straight—Leo said I can help on the day, but do you know where I’m meant to show up for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure of the exact spot yet, Oren, but I’m checking details while I ask around about supplies. I’ll confirm with Cleo or Kira and let you know as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam, that’s a help. I’ll wait for your word from Cleo or Kira, and I’ll try to write it down this time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Pia — I’m checking the repair list and signup sheet before I assign anything, but Leo says the loose porch rail and Mrs. Park’s leaking gutter are urgent first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh good, thank you—let’s put the porch rail and Mrs. Park’s gutter at the top, but please make sure each has a tool list and a time slot so we don’t send people over unprepared.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the tools needed and add a time slot for each before we ask anyone to show up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, sorry I’m sliding in late again. I’m checking with a few folks on my end about busted lamps and small appliances, and it sounds like we also need a clear list of what tools people can bring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No worries, Dane—tools list is a good call. Can you jot what your folks can bring, and I’ll fold it in when I get the fuller repair list together?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, I can do that. I’ll ask this afternoon who’s got basics like screwdrivers, pliers, maybe a soldering iron, and I’ll send you whatever I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Jules, I might be a little behind, but I think folks are still sorting out the repair priorities and checking what supplies are actually in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah—that’s helpful to know. I’ll hold off on promising specific fixes and focus the signup list on who has tools, parts, or time until the priorities and community room supplies are clearer.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds smart, Jules—maybe note that Cleo’s double-checking the tape and screws, and Nell offered to ask around about what people need most.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Leo, I’m glad you’re here—right now we’re setting the repair drive for 10 to noon, and I’m pulling together a list of repairable items and who can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara—put the porch rail and Mrs. Park’s leaking gutter at the top. Oren can help on the day, but I don’t have any tools or supplies promised yet.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo—I’ll put the porch rail and Mrs. Park’s gutter at the top, and note Oren as helping on the day. I’ll keep chasing tool and supply volunteers so we know what’s covered before 10 to noon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Rosa, before I pass this along, can you confirm the exact date, time, and location for the repair drive—and whether the community center is definitely organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking, Kira—I can confirm we’re using the community room as the main drop-off for now, but I don’t have a final date or time yet. I’d say it’s being coordinated by the block group, not officially the community center, unless we get that confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Rosa—that helps, but I’ll hold off on telling folks until the date and time are final. Can you let me know once the block group confirms whether the community center is officially involved or just providing the room?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
